2026-08-06ESDCDepartment of Employment and Social Development ActRegulations Amending the Social Insurance Number Regulations Regulations Amending the Social Insurance Number Regulations in order to (1) require an attestation by the person to be registered (if they are 12 years of age or older), their parent, or their legal representative, instead of a signature; (2) change the Canada Employment Insurance Commission’s existing authority to assign a SIN from optional to mandatory where someone is required by law to have one but refuses to apply; and (3) correct the discrepancies between English and French versions.Registration: SOR/2026-0176 Publication Date: 2026-08-26
act: Department of Employment and Social Development Act
subject: Regulations Amending the Social Insurance Number Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Social Insurance Number Regulations in order to (1) require an attestation by the person to be registered (if they are 12 years of age or older), their parent, or their legal representative, instead of a signature; (2) change the Canada Employment Insurance Commission’s existing authority to assign a SIN from optional to mandatory where someone is required by law to have one but refuses to apply; and (3) correct the discrepancies between English and French versions.
